name: Coven Queens Halloween Show
price: £10 to £35 depending on night and seat
title: Coven Queens Halloween show at Funny Girls
metaDescription: Coven Queens, the Halloween drag show at Funny Girls, runs Wednesday to Sunday until 1 November 2026. Standing from £10, doors 7pm, strictly 18+.
summary: Funny Girls' Halloween drag spectacular, running Wednesday to Sunday until Sunday 1 November 2026.
body:
**Coven Queens** is the Halloween show at Funny Girls, the art deco drag cabaret on Dickson Road. It opened on 16 September 2026 and runs Wednesday to Sunday until Sunday 1 November.

Expect classic movie monsters, Broadway-style witches and a few brand new monsters, with comedy, big musical numbers, dance and plenty of costume changes. Be warned: the show uses pyrotechnics, loud bangs and sudden noises.

**Times:** doors open at 7pm, the host is on from 8pm and the show runs from 8.30pm to about 11.30pm. Strictly 18+.

**Prices:** standing tickets are £10 on Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, £13 on Friday and £14.50 on Saturday. Seats range from £17 in the dress circle midweek up to £35 for a premium stage-side seat on a Saturday. A three-course dinner in the restaurant before the show costs £29.85, and dinner-and-show bundles can save you money.

**Tip:** Friday and Saturday nights sell out first, so book ahead. Call the box office on 01253 649150 if you have access needs.

name: Christmas Sleigh Queens
title: Christmas Sleigh Queens at Funny Girls
metaDescription: Christmas Sleigh Queens, the festive drag cabaret at Funny Girls Blackpool, runs 12 November 2026 to 3 January 2027. Standing from £10, seats £17 to £35, 18+.
summary: The festive drag cabaret season at Funny Girls, from 12 November 2026 to 3 January 2027.
body:
**Christmas Sleigh Queens** is the Christmas show at Funny Girls, taking over from the Halloween run on Thursday 12 November 2026 and playing until Sunday 3 January 2027.

It opens with a festive overture and then works through holiday classics with a comic twist, including Funny Girls takes on *White Christmas*, *Elf* and *Swine Lake*, with big dance routines and costume changes. The 1939 art deco auditorium is dressed as a winter wonderland for the run.

**When:** Mondays and Wednesday to Sunday (no shows on Tuesdays). Doors open at 7pm, the host is on from 8pm and the show runs from 8.30pm to about 11.30pm. Strictly 18+.

**Prices:** standing tickets are £10 on weekdays and Sundays, £13 on Fridays and £14.50 on Saturdays. Seats range from £17 in the rear dress circle midweek to £35 for a premium stage-side seat on a Saturday.

**Tip:** the Christmas season runs alongside the Christmas by the Sea village on the Promenade, a short walk away, so you can make a full evening of it. Book early if you want a Friday or Saturday seat.

name: New Year's Eve 2026 at Funny Girls
title: New Year's Eve 2026 drag party at Funny Girls
metaDescription: See in 2027 at Funny Girls with a New Year's Eve drag cabaret party and midnight countdown. Doors 7pm, standing £16, seats £29.50 to £36, 18+.
summary: A New Year's Eve drag cabaret party with a midnight countdown finale at Funny Girls.
body:
Funny Girls is seeing in 2027 with a **New Year's Eve drag cabaret party** on Thursday 31 December 2026.

The show mixes Hollywood musical tributes, Rockettes-style high kicks and farce-inspired comedy, building up to a midnight countdown finale inside the 1939 art deco former Odeon on Dickson Road.

**Times:** doors open at 7pm, the DJ and hostess start at 8pm and the show begins at 8.30pm. The venue closes at 1am.

**Prices:** standing tickets are £16 and seats cost £29.50 to £36.

**Good to know:** it is strictly 18+. Dinner-and-show bundles don't offer a saving on New Year's Eve, so if you want to eat in the restaurant first, compare the prices before you book. This is one of the busiest nights of the year at Funny Girls, so don't leave it late.

name: Slay Another Day
title: Slay Another Day at Funny Girls, January 2027
metaDescription: Slay Another Day is a short January run at Funny Girls in Blackpool, on Friday and Saturday nights from 8 to 16 January 2027. Standing from £13, seats £26 to £35, 18+.
summary: A short January show at Funny Girls, on Friday and Saturday nights from 8 to 16 January 2027.
body:
**Slay Another Day** is a short run at Funny Girls on Friday and Saturday nights between 8 and 16 January 2027, filling the gap between the Christmas season and the spring show.

Funny Girls bills it as a glamorous, high-energy revue: feathers, top hats, big routines, comedy and well-known musical numbers, under the tagline "Because resolutions fade, but the glamour lasts forever!"

**Times:** doors open at 7pm, the host is on from 8pm and the show runs from 8.30pm to about 11.30pm. Strictly 18+.

**Prices:** standing tickets are £13 on Fridays and £14.50 on Saturdays. Seats cost £26 to £35 depending on the night and where you sit.

**Tip:** January is one of the quietest and cheapest times to visit Blackpool, so it is a good month to grab a better seat or a guesthouse deal in the Rainbow Quarter.

name: Queens of the Knights
title: Queens of the Knights diva special at Funny Girls
metaDescription: Queens of the Knights is a two-night diva anthem special at Funny Girls on 6 and 7 November 2026, led by Phoenix Knights. Standing from £13, 18+.
summary: A two-night special of reimagined diva anthems at Funny Girls, led by Phoenix Knights.
body:
**Queens of the Knights** is a two-nights-only special at Funny Girls on Friday 6 and Saturday 7 November 2026, slotted in between the Halloween and Christmas shows.

It reimagines diva anthems from the likes of Whitney, Mariah and Celine, with gold costumes and full choreography. Company favourite **Phoenix Knights** leads the show.

**Times:** the show runs from 8.30pm to about 11.30pm. Funny Girls usually opens its doors at 7pm, with a host on from 8pm.

**Prices:** standing tickets are £13 on the Friday and £14.50 on the Saturday. Seats cost from £26 to £35 depending on where you sit.

**Good to know:** strictly 18+. With only two performances, seats are likely to go quickly. You can pair the show with the three-course pre-show dinner in the restaurant, though bundles don't save money on Saturdays.

name: Hello Gorgeous! Spring Show
recurrenceText: Wednesday to Sunday during the run
title: Hello Gorgeous! spring show at Funny Girls 2027
metaDescription: Hello Gorgeous! is the 2027 spring drag show at Funny Girls, running Wednesday to Sunday from 21 January to 2 May. Standing from £10, strictly 18+.
summary: Funny Girls' main spring production for 2027, playing Wednesday to Sunday from 21 January to 2 May.
body:
**Hello Gorgeous!** is the main spring production at Funny Girls, running Wednesday to Sunday from 21 January to 2 May 2027.

It is billed as a show of high-kicking dance, comedy and costumes: the classic Funny Girls formula on the new runway stage that arrived when the venue changed hands in 2026.

**Times:** the show plays from 8.30pm to about 11.30pm. Doors usually open at 7pm, with a host on from 8pm.

**Prices:** standing tickets cost £10 to £14.50 and seats £17 to £35, depending on the night and where you sit. Weekends cost more than midweek.

**Good to know:** strictly 18+. A three-course dinner in the art deco restaurant before the show costs £29.85, and dinner-and-show bundles can save money on most nights. Midweek in late winter is usually the easiest time to get a good seat.

name: Spring Fling
title: Spring Fling weekend show at Funny Girls 2027
metaDescription: Spring Fling is a weekend party show of glamour and comedy at Funny Girls, Friday 7 to Sunday 9 May 2027. Standing from £10, seats to £35, 18+.
summary: A three-night weekend party show of glamour and comedy at Funny Girls in May 2027.
body:
**Spring Fling** is a weekend party show at Funny Girls from Friday 7 to Sunday 9 May 2027, between the end of the spring show and the start of the summer season.

Funny Girls describes it as a celebration of glamour and comedy, with the feel of a bank holiday weekend party.

**Times:** the show runs from 8.30pm to about 11.30pm each night. Doors at Funny Girls usually open at 7pm.

**Prices:** standing tickets cost £10 to £14.50 and seats £17 to £35, depending on the night and where you sit.

**Good to know:** strictly 18+. It is a short, three-night run on a weekend, so book early if you want to sit down. The venue is a couple of minutes' walk from Blackpool North station, and Oscars upstairs carries on the party after the show.

name: Heatwave! The Summer Spectacular
recurrenceText: Wednesday to Sunday during the run
title: Heatwave! summer show at Funny Girls 2027
metaDescription: Heatwave! The Summer Spectacular is Funny Girls' 2027 summer drag show, Wednesday to Sunday from 13 May to 5 September. Standing from £10, 18+.
summary: The 2027 summer season show at Funny Girls, running Wednesday to Sunday from 13 May to 5 September.
body:
**Heatwave! The Summer Spectacular** is the 2027 summer season show at Funny Girls, running Wednesday to Sunday from 13 May to 5 September.

Funny Girls promises dazzling costumes, outrageous comedy and non-stop glamour. The summer show is the venue's longest run of the year and covers Pride weekend, which usually falls in early June.

**Times:** the show plays from 8.30pm to about 11.30pm. Doors usually open at 7pm.

**Prices:** standing tickets cost £10 to £14.50 and seats £17 to £35, depending on the night and where you sit.

**Good to know:** strictly 18+. Summer weekends and Pride weekend are the busiest nights, so book well ahead if you're coming then. A three-course pre-show dinner is available in the restaurant, and dinner-and-show bundles save money except on Saturdays.

name: Pre-show dinner at Garbo's
title: Pre-show dinner at Garbo's, Funny Girls
metaDescription: Eat before the show at Garbo's, the art deco restaurant inside Funny Girls. Three courses for £29.85, served from 6pm on show nights. Book ahead.
summary: A three-course dinner in the art deco restaurant at Funny Girls before the evening's drag show.
body:
If you want to make a proper night of it, Funny Girls serves a **three-course pre-show dinner** in Garbo's, its art deco restaurant, on show nights.

**When:** arrive between 6pm and 6.30pm. Dinner runs until about 8pm, in time for the host at 8pm and the show at 8.30pm. Funny Girls shows normally run Wednesday to Sunday.

**Price:** £29.85 per person for three courses. You can book dinner on its own or as a dinner-and-show bundle, which works out cheaper on most nights. Bundles don't save money on Saturdays or New Year's Eve, so check before you buy.

**Good to know:** the whole venue is strictly 18+. You're welcome to decorate your table or bring a cake if you're celebrating, and it is worth phoning ahead on 01253 649150 about access or dietary needs.

name: Funny Girls Aftershow at Oscars
recurrenceText: Wednesday to Saturday after the show
title: Funny Girls aftershow party at Oscars
metaDescription: Keep going after Funny Girls at Oscars, the late bar in the same building, with karaoke and live music from Wednesday to Saturday after the show.
summary: Karaoke and live music at Oscars, the late bar in the Funny Girls building, once the show finishes.
body:
When the curtain comes down at Funny Girls, the party moves to **Oscars**, the late bar in the same building at 5 Dickson Road.

**What's on:** karaoke and live music after the show, from about 11pm, Wednesday to Saturday.

**Times:** Oscars opens from 9pm on Friday and Saturday and stays open until about 2am. On Wednesday and Thursday it opens late for the aftershow crowd.

**Price:** no entry price is published, so check at the door.

**Tip:** it is the easiest way to round off a show night without walking anywhere. If you fancy a change of scene, Queen Street and the rest of the Rainbow Quarter are only a few minutes away. The building is 18+.

name: Betty Legs Diamond and Zoe: Together Again
title: Betty Legs Diamond and Zoe on Central Pier
metaDescription: Betty Legs Diamond and Zoe reunite for Together Again at the Central Pier Show Bar, a summer drag comedy show running until 31 October 2026.
summary: Two long-standing Blackpool drag names reunite for a summer-season show on Central Pier, running until 31 October 2026.
body:
**Together Again** reunites two of Blackpool's longest-standing drag names, **Betty Legs Diamond** and **Zoe**, at the Central Pier Show Bar. Both are best known for years at Funny Girls, and this season they share the bill on the pier.

The show mixes comedy, flamboyant costumes and dance routines, with showcase dancers backing them up. The season started on 20 June 2026 and finishes on **Saturday 31 October 2026**, so there are only a few weeks left to catch it.

**Times and prices** aren't published, so call Central Pier on 01253 623422 to check show days and book.

**Tip:** Central Pier is on the Promenade, about a 15-minute walk south of the Rainbow Quarter, or a short tram ride. Pair it with a walk under the Illuminations, which run along the seafront until 1 November.

name: Love, Loss & Living: Through an LGBTQ+ Lens
title: Love, Loss & Living at Funny Girls
metaDescription: A daytime session of music, stories and conversation about LGBTQ+ love and loss at Funny Girls on Sunday 11 October 2026, with Electric Pink Voices.
summary: A Sunday lunchtime of music, storytelling and conversation about LGBTQ+ love, loss and community at Funny Girls.
body:
**Love, Loss & Living: Through an LGBTQ+ Lens** is a daytime event at Funny Girls on **Sunday 11 October 2026**, from noon to 1.45pm.

It opens with music and storytelling about LGBTQ+ love and loss. Then BBC Lancashire hosts a conversation about building LGBTQ+ spaces in Blackpool and living through the AIDS era. The session closes with **Electric Pink Voices**, Blackpool's LGBTQ+ choir, singing a newly commissioned arrangement.

It is a rare chance to hear the story of the scene from someone who helped build it, in the venue he founded.

**Tickets:** the price isn't published on the listings we've seen, so check the ticket page before you go.

**Tip:** it finishes in time for a Sunday roast in the Rainbow Quarter, with several venues serving every Sunday.

name: Diamonds Showbar: UK Tour
title: Diamonds Showbar festive drag show at Viva
metaDescription: The Diamonds Showbar UK Tour brings a festive drag show with Heffa Trott and the Diamond Divas to Viva Blackpool on 9 December 2026. From £28.50.
summary: A touring festive drag show with lip-sync, live vocals and comedy at Viva Blackpool on 9 December 2026.
body:
The **Diamonds Showbar UK Tour** stops at Viva Blackpool on **Wednesday 9 December 2026** with a festive drag show.

Expect lip-sync, live vocals and comedy from the Diamond Divas and drag performer **Heffa Trott**, plus tribute singers performing as Adele and Pink. Food and drinks are served to your table.

**Times:** doors open at 6.30pm and the show starts at 7.30pm. The Diamond Divas are on from 9.15pm until 11pm.

**Tickets:** from £28.50.

**Good to know:** Viva is on Church Street in the town centre, about ten minutes' walk from the Rainbow Quarter. It is a touring show rather than a local residency, so it is a one-night chance to catch it. It is a good option for a festive group night out if Funny Girls is already booked up.

name: Drag Brunch at Viva
title: Drag brunch at Viva Blackpool, 17 April 2027
metaDescription: Drag-hosted bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool, Saturday 17 April 2027, with comedy, games, a platter and 90 minutes of drinks. From £39.95, 18+.
summary: A drag-hosted bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool on Saturday 17 April 2027.
body:
Viva Blackpool's **Drag Brunch** returns on **Saturday 17 April 2027**, from 1pm to 4pm.

It is a drag-hosted bottomless brunch with comedy, party games and live performances. Your ticket includes a sharing platter and 90 minutes of bottomless drinks.

**Tickets:** from £39.95, or £49.95 with a draught upgrade. It is strictly 18+.

**Good to know:** the hosts and performers for this date haven't been named, so check the booking page nearer the time. Viva is at 3 Church Street in the town centre, around ten minutes' walk from the Rainbow Quarter, so it is easy to carry on into the evening on Queen Street or Lord Street afterwards.

**Tip:** brunches suit birthdays and hen parties, and group tables tend to go first. Eat a proper breakfast if you're planning to make an afternoon and evening of it.

name: Drag Brunch at Viva
title: Drag brunch at Viva Blackpool, 11 September 2027
metaDescription: Drag-hosted bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool, Saturday 11 September 2027, with comedy, games, a platter and 90 minutes of drinks. From £39.95, 18+.
summary: A drag-hosted bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool on Saturday 11 September 2027.
body:
Viva Blackpool runs another **Drag Brunch** on **Saturday 11 September 2027**, from 1pm to 4pm, as the summer season winds down.

The formula is simple: a drag host, comedy, party games and live performances, with a sharing platter and 90 minutes of bottomless drinks included in the ticket.

**Tickets:** from £39.95, or £49.95 if you'd like the draught upgrade. Strictly 18+.

**Good to know:** the line-up for this date hasn't been announced, so check the booking page closer to the day. Viva is at 3 Church Street, about ten minutes' walk from the Rainbow Quarter. In September the Illuminations are usually lit along the seafront, so you can finish the day with a walk along the Promenade.

**Tip:** if you're coming as a group, book together so you're seated together, and pace yourself: there's a whole evening in the quarter still to come.

name: Drag Brunch at Viva
title: Drag brunch at Viva Blackpool, 18 December 2027
metaDescription: Drag-hosted bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool, Saturday 18 December 2027, with comedy, games, a platter and 90 minutes of drinks. From £39.95, 18+.
summary: A drag-hosted bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool on Saturday 18 December 2027.
body:
The last **Drag Brunch** of the year at Viva Blackpool is on **Saturday 18 December 2027**, from 1pm to 4pm, a week before Christmas.

You get a drag-hosted afternoon of comedy, party games and live performances, with a sharing platter and 90 minutes of bottomless drinks.

**Tickets:** from £39.95, or £49.95 with the draught upgrade. Strictly 18+.

**Good to know:** the host for this date hasn't been named yet, so check the booking page nearer the time. Viva is at 3 Church Street in the town centre, around ten minutes' walk from the Rainbow Quarter.

**Tip:** a mid-December Saturday is peak party season in Blackpool, so it is a natural pick for a work do or a festive catch-up with friends. Book early, and plan how you're getting home, as taxis are in demand on December weekends.

name: Myra DuBois: Siren
title: Myra DuBois: Siren at Blackpool Grand Theatre
metaDescription: Comedy drag diva Myra DuBois brings her new touring show Siren to Blackpool Grand Theatre on Thursday 13 May 2027, with songs and sharp crowd work.
summary: Comedy drag diva Myra DuBois brings her new touring show to the Grand Theatre on 13 May 2027.
body:
Comedy drag diva **Myra DuBois** brings her new touring show, **Siren**, to Blackpool Grand Theatre on **Thursday 13 May 2027** at 7.30pm.

The show mixes concert-style songs with Myra's sharp crowd work, and she is backed by the Fabulous Myrettes and Rose Lavender. If you like your drag with plenty of audience interaction, sitting near the front is a brave choice.

**Tickets:** prices haven't been published yet. Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster.

**Good to know:** the Grand is at 33 Church Street in the town centre, about ten minutes' walk from the Rainbow Quarter. The show starts at 7.30pm, which leaves plenty of time for a drink on Queen Street or Lord Street afterwards. It falls on the same day the Funny Girls summer show opens, if you fancy a double bill over a weekend away.

name: Smalltown Boy: Re-live the Music of Jimmy Somerville
title: Smalltown Boy Jimmy Somerville tribute at Viva
metaDescription: A live-band tribute to Jimmy Somerville, Bronski Beat and The Communards at Viva Blackpool on Saturday 6 February 2027. Tickets from £17.95.
summary: A live-band tribute night to the music of Jimmy Somerville, Bronski Beat and The Communards at Viva Blackpool.
body:
**Smalltown Boy** is a live-band tribute to the music of Jimmy Somerville, Bronski Beat and The Communards, at Viva Blackpool on **Saturday 6 February 2027**.

Expect the 80s synth-pop anthems, including Smalltown Boy and Don't Leave Me This Way. It is a tribute show, so Jimmy Somerville himself doesn't appear, and it is a general Viva event rather than one run by the LGBTQ+ scene.

**Times:** doors at 6.30pm, the show at 8pm, and an after-show from 10pm.

**Tickets:** from £17.95. Ages 12 and over.

**Good to know:** Viva is at 3 Church Street, around ten minutes' walk from the Rainbow Quarter, so you can head to Queen Street or Lord Street once the after-show winds down. Early February is quiet in Blackpool, so it is a good weekend to find a cheaper room in one of the quarter's guesthouses.

name: Rocky Horror Bottomless Brunch
title: Rocky Horror Halloween brunch at Viva Blackpool
metaDescription: A Rocky Horror themed bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool on Halloween, Saturday 31 October 2026, with live vocalists and fancy dress. From £39.95.
summary: A Rocky Horror themed Halloween bottomless brunch at Viva Blackpool on Saturday 31 October 2026.
body:
Do the Time Warp on Halloween afternoon at Viva Blackpool's **Rocky Horror Bottomless Brunch**, on **Saturday 31 October 2026** from 1pm to 4pm.

The cult classic is the theme, with live vocalists and a DJ host, plus a sharing platter and bottomless drinks. Fancy dress is encouraged, so dig out the fishnets.

**Tickets:** from £39.95. Strictly 18+.

**Good to know:** there are no drag performers advertised for this one; it is a themed brunch rather than a drag show. Viva is at 3 Church Street, about ten minutes' walk from the Rainbow Quarter.

**Tip:** it finishes at 4pm, which leaves time to change and head out for Halloween night. Funny Girls' Coven Queens and the Sanderson Sisters themed takeover at McGraths are both on that evening. More Rocky Horror brunches are listed at Viva for 7 August and 16 October 2027.

name: LGBTQ+ Swimming Group
title: LGBTQ+ swimming group in Blackpool, monthly
metaDescription: A free monthly LGBTQ+ swim in Blackpool on the last Thursday of the month, 8.30pm to 9.30pm, with sole use of the pool and a coach. Register first.
summary: A free private pool hour for LGBTQ+ swimmers on the last Thursday of every month, with a qualified coach on hand.
body:
Lancashire LGBT runs a **monthly LGBTQ+ swim** in Blackpool on the **last Thursday of every month**, from 8.30pm to 9.30pm. The next session is on **Thursday 29 October 2026**.

The group has sole use of the pool for the hour, and a qualified coach is there if you'd like help with your technique or want to learn to swim from scratch. All abilities are welcome and the changing rooms are unisex.

**Where:** the pool at Moor Park Leisure Centre on Bristol Avenue in Bispham. Check the venue when you register, just in case it has changed.

**Price:** free, though donations are appreciated.

**How to join:** you need to register before your first visit, using the link on this page. It is a relaxed, friendly way to meet people outside the bars, and a good fit if you're new to the area.

name: Where We Belong: Sandgrown Song Cycle
title: Where We Belong: LGBTQ+ songs at Blackpool Grand
metaDescription: Six Blackpool choirs sing six new songs inspired by LGBTQ+ lives in the town at Blackpool Grand Theatre on Sunday 8 November 2026. Tickets £15.
summary: Six local choirs premiere new songs inspired by the stories of LGBTQ+ people in Blackpool, at the Grand Theatre.
body:
**Where We Belong: Sandgrown Song Cycle** is a one-night concert at Blackpool Grand Theatre on **Sunday 8 November 2026**, where six local choirs sing six new songs inspired by the experiences of LGBTQ+ people in Blackpool.

The words grew out of stories shared through local community groups, and the choirs taking part are BMS Contemporary Choir, Blackpool Male Voice Choir, Capricorn Singers, Waterloo Women's Choir, Encore Singers and **Electric Pink Voices**, the town's LGBTQ+ community choir.

**Times:** doors open at 6.30pm and the performance starts at 7.30pm.

**Tickets:** £15 plus booking fees, from the Grand's website or the box office on 01253 290190.

**Good to know:** the complete song cycle is due to premiere at the Hand in Hand LGBTQ+ choir festival when it comes to Blackpool in August 2027, so this is an early chance to hear it at home.

name: Hand in Hand Festival 2027
title: Hand in Hand LGBTQ+ choir festival, Blackpool 2027
metaDescription: Hand in Hand, the UK and Ireland's national LGBTQ+ choir festival, comes to Blackpool from Friday 13 to Sunday 15 August 2027.
summary: The UK and Ireland's national LGBTQ+ choir festival, in Blackpool for a weekend in August 2027.
body:
**Hand in Hand** is the national LGBTQ+ choir festival for the UK and Ireland, held every two years. The 2027 edition comes to **Blackpool from Friday 13 to Sunday 15 August 2027**.

Expect a weekend of performances from LGBTQ+ choirs from across the UK and Ireland, plus community events around town. Participating choirs list the Winter Gardens and the Tower Ballroom as festival venues.

The full **Where We Belong** song cycle, written with Blackpool choirs and inspired by local LGBTQ+ stories, is due to premiere at the festival.

**Good to know:** the detailed programme, times and tickets haven't been published yet. Mid-August is peak season in Blackpool, so if you're travelling for it, book accommodation early. Check the festival website for updates.

name: Electric Pink Voices rehearsals
title: Electric Pink Voices LGBTQ+ choir rehearsals
metaDescription: Join Electric Pink Voices, Blackpool's LGBTQ+ community choir, at weekly Tuesday evening rehearsals at The Old Electric. New members welcome.
summary: Weekly Tuesday rehearsals for Blackpool's LGBTQ+ community choir, open to new members.
body:
**Electric Pink Voices** is Blackpool's LGBTQ+ community choir, and it rehearses **every Tuesday from 6.30pm** at The Old Electric on Springfield Road, on the edge of the Rainbow Quarter.

New members are welcome. If you've been looking for a way to meet people that doesn't revolve around a bar, a choir is a lovely option, and you don't need to be a trained singer to give it a go.

The choir pops up at community events around town. It is closing the **Love, Loss & Living** event at Funny Girls on Sunday 11 October 2026 with a newly commissioned arrangement, and it has sung at heritage events at Showtown in the past.

On **Sunday 8 November 2026** it is one of six choirs singing the new **Where We Belong** song cycle, inspired by Blackpool LGBTQ+ stories, at Blackpool Grand Theatre.

**Good to know:** we don't know the finish time for rehearsals. Get in touch with the choir before your first visit to check the session is on.

name: LGBTQ+ football sessions
venueAddress: Blackpool Aspire Academy, Blackpool Old Road, Blackpool
title: Weekly LGBTQ+ football at Aspire Sports Hub
metaDescription: Inclusive Monday evening football for LGBTQ+ people and allies of any ability, run by Blackpool FC Community Trust. Check sessions are running first.
summary: Inclusive weekly football sessions for LGBTQ+ people and allies of any ability.
body:
Blackpool FC Community Trust has run **inclusive football sessions** for LGBTQ+ people and allies on **Monday evenings from 7pm to 8pm** at Aspire Sports Hub at Blackpool Aspire Academy.

The sessions are open to any ability, so you don't need to have played before. They are a good way to get active, meet people and enjoy the game in a welcoming setting.

**Please check before you go:** the details we have date from when the sessions launched, and we haven't been able to confirm they're still running every week. Contact Blackpool FC Community Trust to check the current day, time and any cost before you turn up.

**Getting there:** the hub is in Layton, away from the Rainbow Quarter, so allow time for a bus or taxi.

name: GROWL
title: GROWL bears afternoon at Acqua Sauna
metaDescription: GROWL is a men-only afternoon for bears, cubs, chasers and admirers at Acqua Sauna, Springfield Road, on Saturday 17 October 2026 from noon to 6pm.
summary: A men-only afternoon social for bears, cubs, chasers and admirers at Acqua Sauna on 17 October 2026.
body:
**GROWL** is an afternoon social at Acqua Sauna on **Saturday 17 October 2026**, from noon to 6pm, aimed at bears, cubs, chasers and admirers.

Hot food is served at 4pm, so you can make a full afternoon of it.

**Who it's for:** men only, 18+.

**Where:** Acqua is at 25-27a Springfield Road, a couple of minutes' walk from Blackpool North station and on the edge of the Rainbow Quarter.

**Price:** the entry price isn't published, so check with Acqua before you go.

**Tip:** it is a busy weekend for bears in town. The Bare & Bark weekend at Welhorny's on Banks Street starts the next day, and on the same Saturday evening Marigold Addams is performing at Rendezvous on Lord Street.

name: Marigold Addams as Jane McDonald
title: Marigold Addams as Jane McDonald at Rendezvous
metaDescription: Drag performer Marigold Addams returns to Rendezvous Bar on Lord Street for a Jane McDonald tribute set on Saturday 17 October 2026, 8pm to 10pm.
summary: Marigold Addams returns to Rendezvous Bar for a Jane McDonald tribute set on 17 October 2026.
body:
Drag performer **Marigold Addams** is back at Rendezvous Bar on Lord Street on **Saturday 17 October 2026**, from 8pm to 10pm, with a **Jane McDonald** tribute set.

If you love a big ballad and a bit of cruise-ship glamour, this is your night. Rendezvous is a small, friendly bar, so a set like this feels close-up and personal.

**Price:** entry details aren't published, so check with the bar. Most Rainbow Quarter bars are free to get into, but it is worth asking.

**Where:** Rendezvous Bar, 15-17 Lord Street, in the middle of the quarter.

**Tip:** it finishes at 10pm, leaving the rest of the night free for Lord Street's other bars, or a short walk to Queen Street. Get there early if you want a seat, as small venues fill up quickly on a Saturday.

name: Bare & Bark: Bears & Pups Weekend
title: Bare & Bark bears and pups weekend at Welhorny's
metaDescription: Bare & Bark is a three-day bears and pups weekend at Welhorny's, the men-only naturist guesthouse on Banks Street, from 18 to 20 October 2026.
summary: A three-day bears and pup-play weekend at Welhorny's, from 18 to 20 October 2026.
body:
**Bare & Bark** is a three-day bears and pups weekend at **Welhorny's**, 33 to 37 Banks Street, from **Sunday 18 to Tuesday 20 October 2026**.

Pups and other K9s are welcome alongside bears, so it is a meet-up for both crowds.

**Where:** Welhorny's is a men-only naturist members' guesthouse on Banks Street, in the Rainbow Quarter.

**Who it's for:** men only, 18+.

**Price and times:** these aren't published, so contact Welhorny's directly to check what's included and whether you need to book a room or a day pass.

**Tip:** the weekend starts the day after GROWL at Acqua Sauna on Saturday 17 October, so you could make a long weekend of it.

name: Halloween at McGraths
title: Halloween drag at McGraths, Lord Street
metaDescription: Halloween at McGraths on Lord Street brings a Sanderson Sisters themed drag takeover on Saturday 31 October 2026, from 8pm to 11pm.
summary: A Sanderson Sisters themed drag takeover at McGraths on Halloween night.
body:
McGraths on Lord Street is marking Halloween with a **Sanderson Sisters themed drag takeover** on **Saturday 31 October 2026**, from 8pm to 11pm.

If Hocus Pocus is your Halloween film of choice, this is the one for you: a live cabaret from the Sanderson Sisters in a bar known for its resident drag queens and singers.

**Price:** entry details aren't published, so check with the bar.

**Where:** McGraths Irish Bar, 87 Lord Street, in the heart of the Rainbow Quarter.

**Tip:** Halloween is one of the busiest nights of the year in the quarter. Dress up, get there early and plan your route home, as taxis are in demand. If you want a full day of it, the Rocky Horror brunch at Viva runs earlier that afternoon, and Coven Queens plays at Funny Girls the same evening.

name: Rainbow Quarter Community Street Party
venueAddress: Lord Street and around, Blackpool town centre
title: Rainbow Quarter Street Party, June 2027
metaDescription: The Rainbow Quarter community street party returns from 4 to 6 June 2027, after about 3,000 people joined the 2026 party. Save the date.
summary: The Rainbow Quarter's own community street party returns for a summer weekend, 4 to 6 June 2027.
body:
Save the date: the **Rainbow Quarter Community Street Party** is coming back from **Friday 4 to Sunday 6 June 2027**.

It has run every Pride weekend since 2024. In June 2026 Lord Street became a free street party from Springfield Road to Cocker Street. More than 20 local businesses organised it together, with DJs in the afternoon and live entertainment in the evening, and about 3,000 people came along over two days. Organisers have said they're planning a bigger edition for 2027.

**What we don't know yet:** the 2027 programme, opening times and whether entry will again be free with a wristband. We'll update this page as details are announced.

**Tip:** Pride weekend usually falls in early June too, so expect the town to be very busy. Book your room in the quarter early.

name: We're Still Here! LGBTQIA+ heritage exhibitions
venueAddress: Showtown, Bank Hey Street, and Grundy Art Gallery, Blackpool
title: We're Still Here! LGBTQIA+ exhibitions 2027
metaDescription: Two LGBTQIA+ heritage exhibitions at Showtown and the Grundy Art Gallery, planned for February to June 2027, drawing on Blackpool's community memories.
summary: Two exhibitions at Showtown and the Grundy drawing on community memories and archive photos, planned for February to June 2027.
body:
The **We're Still Here!** heritage project is planning two exhibitions in 2027, one at **Showtown** and one at the **Grundy Art Gallery**, running across **February to June 2027**.

They draw on community memories and archive photographs to mark 20 years of Blackpool Pride. The project also links them to two anniversaries: 60 years since the 1967 Act and 40 years since Section 28.

We're Still Here! is run by Abingdon Studios with National Lottery Heritage Fund support, and is building Blackpool's first permanent collection of LGBTQIA+ heritage.

**Dates to be confirmed:** only the February to June window has been announced so far, so check exact opening dates and times before you visit.

**Get involved:** if you have photos, stories or objects from the scene, the project would love to hear from you.

name: Lady and the Camp
title: Lady and the Camp at The Flying Handbag
metaDescription: Lady and the Camp is an occasional Sunday afternoon show at The Flying Handbag on Queen Street. Dates are announced locally, so check before you go.
summary: An occasional Sunday afternoon show at The Flying Handbag, with dates announced through the year.
body:
**Lady and the Camp** is an occasional Sunday afternoon show at The Flying Handbag on Queen Street, running on selected dates through 2026.

The venue hasn't published the specific dates, times or prices, and announces each one locally, so check with the bar before you plan around it.

The Flying Handbag is one of the biggest venues in the Rainbow Quarter, with a cabaret stage, a sun terrace and food served all day. A Sunday there also means Sunday lunch, served from noon to 5pm, so you could book a table and stay on for the show if one is running.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street. It is 18+, so bring ID.

**Tip:** if there isn't a show on the Sunday you visit, Garlands on Talbot Road has drag every day, including a Sunday comedy drag show.

name: Monday Mayhem
title: Monday Mayhem at The Flying Handbag
metaDescription: Monday Mayhem runs every Monday at The Flying Handbag on Queen Street, from 8pm until 3am, with karaoke on the same night. 18+, bring ID.
summary: The Flying Handbag's late Monday night, from 8pm until 3am every week.
body:
**Monday Mayhem** is The Flying Handbag's weekly Monday night, running from **8pm until 3am**.

It is proof that Blackpool doesn't stop just because it is a Monday. Karaoke also runs on Monday nights, so if you've been saving a power ballad all weekend, this is your moment.

**Price:** no entry charge is published. Most quarter bars are free to get into during the week, but check at the door.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street, a purpose-built LGBTQ+ bar with a sun terrace and a late licence. It is 18+, so bring ID.

**Tip:** if you're in town for a long weekend, Monday is a good night to see the quarter with smaller crowds. Garlands has its Monday drag a short walk away on Talbot Road.

name: QuizMania with Amber
title: QuizMania with Miss Amber at The Flying Handbag
metaDescription: QuizMania is a weekly comedy quiz hosted by drag host Miss Amber at The Flying Handbag, every Wednesday from 4pm to 8pm. Karaoke follows.
summary: A Wednesday afternoon comedy quiz at The Flying Handbag, hosted by resident drag host Miss Amber.
body:
**QuizMania** is a comedy quiz hosted by resident drag host **Miss Amber** at The Flying Handbag, every **Wednesday from 4pm to 8pm**.

It is an early-evening quiz, so it suits anyone who'd rather be done by dinner time, and Miss Amber's hosting means you're there for the laughs as much as the questions. Gather a team, or turn up and see who adopts you.

**Price:** no entry fee is published, so check on the day.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street. Food is served all day, so you can eat while you play. It is 18+, so bring ID.

**Tip:** karaoke also runs on Wednesdays, so stay on once the quiz is done. Funny Girls opens its doors at 7pm on Wednesdays if you fancy moving on to a show.

name: Karaoke at The Flying Handbag
title: Karaoke nights at The Flying Handbag
metaDescription: Karaoke runs three nights a week at The Flying Handbag on Queen Street: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Times aren't published, so check first.
summary: Karaoke three nights a week at The Flying Handbag on Queen Street.
body:
The Flying Handbag runs **karaoke every Monday, Wednesday and Thursday**.

It is one of the easiest ways to join in at the biggest bar on Queen Street, whether you're a confident belter or just there for moral support. Karaoke sits alongside the other weekly nights: Monday Mayhem on Mondays, QuizMania on Wednesday afternoons, and Thirsty Thursday and the Take It or Leave It game show on Thursdays.

**Times:** start times for karaoke aren't published, so check with the bar. Expect it in the evening.

**Price:** no entry charge is published.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street. The bar has a sun terrace, food all day and a late licence. It is 18+, so bring ID.

**Tip:** there is more karaoke nearby at Peek-a-Booze on Dickson Road and at Oscars after the Funny Girls show.

name: Thirsty Thursday with Miss Amber
title: Thirsty Thursday with Miss Amber, Flying Handbag

summary: The Flying Handbag's weekly Thursday night with resident drag host Miss Amber.
body:
**Thirsty Thursday** is The Flying Handbag's weekly Thursday night, fronted by resident drag host **Miss Amber**.

Thursday is a busy night at the Handbag: Thirsty Thursday runs alongside the **Take It or Leave It** game show and karaoke, so there's plenty going on before the weekend proper.

**Times:** start times aren't published, so check with the bar before you go.

**Price:** no entry charge is published.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street, the purpose-built LGBTQ+ bar at the heart of the strip. It is 18+, so bring ID.

**Tip:** Thursday is a good night to visit if you want a lively atmosphere without the full weekend crowds. Funny Girls also plays on Thursdays, and its show finishes in time to catch the end of the night on Queen Street.

name: Take It or Leave It
title: Take It or Leave It game show, Flying Handbag
metaDescription: Take It or Leave It is a weekly Thursday game-show night at The Flying Handbag on Queen Street, alongside Thirsty Thursday and karaoke.
summary: A weekly Thursday game-show night at The Flying Handbag.

It is one of two Thursday nights at the Handbag, alongside **Thirsty Thursday** with Miss Amber, and karaoke runs on Thursdays too. The venue hasn't published how the game works or what you can win, so go along and find out.

**Times:** not published, so check with the bar.

**Price:** no entry charge is published.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street. It has a sun terrace, a heated smoking area, food all day and a late licence. It is 18+, so bring ID.

**Tip:** if game shows are your thing, Peek-a-Booze on Dickson Road also runs bingo with Blankety Blank on Mondays and Play Your Cards Right on Wednesdays.

name: TFI Friday with Miss Amber
title: TFI Friday with Miss Amber at The Flying Handbag
metaDescription: TFI Friday is The Flying Handbag's weekly Friday night with drag host Miss Amber and resident DJ Pudsley, on Queen Street until late. 18+.
summary: The Flying Handbag's Friday night with drag host Miss Amber and resident DJ Pudsley.
body:

Friday is one of the two big nights in the Rainbow Quarter, and the Handbag stays open later at weekends, until about 4am.

**Times:** a start time isn't published, so check with the bar.

**Price:** no entry charge is published. Some bigger venues charge a small fee at weekends, so have a little cash or a card ready.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street. It is 18+, so bring ID.

name: Sunday Lunch at The Flying Handbag
title: Sunday lunch at The Flying Handbag
metaDescription: Sunday lunch is served every week at The Flying Handbag on Queen Street from noon to 5pm. A relaxed start to a Sunday in the Rainbow Quarter.
summary: Weekly Sunday lunch at The Flying Handbag, served from noon to 5pm.
body:
The Flying Handbag serves **Sunday lunch every week from noon to 5pm**.

It is a relaxed way to start a Sunday in the Rainbow Quarter, especially if Saturday night ran late. The Handbag has a sun terrace for warmer days, and food is served all day, every day.

**Price:** menu prices aren't published, so check with the bar.

**Where:** The Flying Handbag, 44 Queen Street. It is 18+, so bring ID.

The Handbag is one of several quarter venues serving a Sunday roast, so if it is full, Mardi Gras and Peek-a-Booze are a short walk away. On selected Sundays the Handbag also puts on its Lady and the Camp afternoon show.

name: Daily drag at Garlands
title: Daily drag at Garlands, Talbot Road

title: Sheela Vim live at Peek-a-Booze
metaDescription: Sheela Vim performs live at Peek-a-Booze on Dickson Road on Sunday 11 October 2026, from 9pm to 11.30pm. A Sunday night show in the Rainbow Quarter.

**Price:** not published, so check at the bar.

**Where:** Peek-a-Booze, 72-74 Dickson Road, a cabaret bar and adults-only budget hotel in the middle of the Rainbow Quarter.

**Tip:** Sunday can be a full day out in the quarter. Start with the Love, Loss & Living session at Funny Girls at noon, have a Sunday roast at one of the quarter's venues, catch the Sunday drag at Garlands and finish with Sheela Vim.

name: GROWLR Club at Man Bar
title: GROWLR Club at Man Bar, Dickson Road
metaDescription: GROWLR Club is the men-only cruise club upstairs at Man Bar on Dickson Road, open at weekends with wristband entry from the bar. Adults only.
summary: A men-only cruise club upstairs at Man Bar, open at weekends with wristband entry.
body:
**GROWLR Club** is the men-only cruise club upstairs at **Man Bar**, 25 Dickson Road. It runs at weekends alongside the bar downstairs.

Upstairs there are themed areas, lockers, a cruise area and an outdoor smoking terrace. Downstairs, Man Bar is a traditional LGBTQ+ bar with pool and drinks offers.

**How to get in:** buy a wristband from the bar.

**Times:** Man Bar opens Friday to Sunday from 8pm. The club's own hours vary between the listings we've seen, with late opening on Fridays and Saturdays until around 2am, so check at the bar.

**Who it's for:** men only, adults only.

**Tip:** Man Bar sits towards the town end of Dickson Road, a few minutes' walk from Funny Girls and Queen Street.

name: Weekend cabaret at Lu-Lu's
title: Weekend cabaret at Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge
metaDescription: Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge on Dickson Road has music and cabaret acts at weekends from 7pm, with a hosted Sunday cocktail night. Check line-ups first.
summary: Music and cabaret acts at Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge on Friday, Saturday and Sunday evenings.
body:
**Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge** on Dickson Road puts on **music and cabaret acts at weekends**, from **7pm on Friday, Saturday and Sunday**.

Lu-Lu's is two bars side by side with a hotel: the cabaret bar for the acts, and a quieter lounge next door if you'd rather talk. Sunday is a hosted cocktail night, and **Crystal Candyfloss** has hosted Sunday evenings there.

**Good to know:** the details we have are a little older, so the current hosts and acts may have changed. Check with Lu-Lu's before you go.

**Price:** not published.

**Where:** Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge, 78b-82 Dickson Road, at the northern end of the village. There are rooms above the bar if you want to stay where you drink.

name: Afternoon and evening entertainment at Rendezvous
recurrenceText: Most afternoons and evenings, Thursday to Sunday

metaDescription: Rendezvous Bar on Lord Street has small-bar entertainment most afternoons and evenings from Thursday to Sunday. Times vary, so check with the bar.

**Rendezvous Bar** at 15-17 Lord Street has **entertainment most afternoons and evenings from Thursday to Sunday**.

It is a small, friendly bar, and a good place for a relaxed start to the night before you head on to the bigger venues. There are rooms upstairs too.

**Times and line-ups:** these aren't published in advance, so check with the bar for what's on.

**Price:** not published. Most Lord Street bars are free to get into.

**Coming up:** drag performer **Marigold Addams** brings her Jane McDonald tribute set to Rendezvous on Saturday 17 October 2026, from 8pm to 10pm.

**Tip:** Lord Street has a run of smaller bars within a few doors of each other, from Mardi Gras and Trades to McGraths and Neon, so it is an easy street to wander.

W3 has three floors of cabins and play areas, plus a lounge and a terrace serving snacks and drinks.

**Times and prices:** these aren't published, so check with W3 before you go.

**Where:** Charles Street is on the town-centre side of the quarter, a short walk from Lord Street and Dickson Road. Acqua Sauna on Springfield Road is the area's other men's sauna, and both are within easy walking distance of the bars.

name: Rainbow Quarter Sunday roasts
title: Sunday roasts in the Rainbow Quarter
metaDescription: Where to find a Sunday roast in Blackpool's Rainbow Quarter, from The Flying Handbag and Mardi Gras to DeLovely and Peek-a-Booze. Every Sunday.
summary: A run of Rainbow Quarter venues serving Sunday roasts every week.
body:
Sunday roasts have become a Rainbow Quarter tradition, with a run of venues serving them **every Sunday**, listed through to the end of 2027.

Places on the list include:

- **The Flying Handbag**, 44 Queen Street (Sunday lunch from noon to 5pm)
- **Peek-a-Booze**, 72-74 Dickson Road
- **Mardi Gras**, 41-43 Lord Street, from 1.30pm
- **31 Queen Street**
- **DeLovely**, Lord Street, by booking
- **The Duke**, Dickson Road
- **Off the Rails Cafe**, High Street

**Prices and times:** these vary by venue and most aren't published, so check with the venue you choose.

**Tip:** book ahead on busy weekends, then roll straight into an afternoon of drag and karaoke without leaving the quarter. Garlands has drag every Sunday from mid-afternoon, including the Lucy Fur Comedy Drag Show.
